title: ‘Person’ == Light-skinned, Western Man, and Sexualization of Women of Color: Stereotypes in Stable Diffusion

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating pairwise CLIP-cosine similarities between images generated from gender-neutral ('person') and gender-specific ('man', 'woman', 'person of nonbinary gender') prompts, and measuring the disproportionate sexualization of women using an NSFW image detector.

Comparing CLIP-cosine similarities between generic 'person' prompts and geographically specific continental or national prompts to evaluate default geographic representations, along with NSFW scoring to detect the fetishization of specific nationalities.

Manual evaluation and visual comparison of generated images to assess the model's default assignment of light skin tones to generic prompts and the erasure of Indigenous and dark-skinned populations (e.g., comparing Oceania outputs to Indigenous populations).
